extra_context: We're a small CPA and bookkeeping shop that handles the day-to-day books and yearly taxes for local small businesses — restaurants, contractors, salons, that kind of thing — plus a handful of individuals who just want their returns done right. Most of our clients came to us scared of the IRS or burned by a previous accountant who went quiet, so what I really want people to feel is calm: like they finally have someone in their corner who picks up the phone. The one thing that sets us apart is we do a free 20-minute "shoebox review" where you bring in whatever messy pile of receipts you've got and we tell you straight what shape you're in, no commitment.
